findings.explanation: HOL4 defines FAPPLY f x = OUTL (fmap_REP f x), and OUTL is specified only on INL (sumScript.sml:286). For x outside FDOM f, the saved theorems give only f ' x = FEMPTY ' x (NOT_FDOM_FAPPLY_FEMPTY), and that value stays unspecified. Lean defines FAPPLY as THE (FLOOKUP f x), so it proves unconditionally FAPPLY f x = THE (FLOOKUP f x), hence FAPPLY FEMPTY x = THE none = ARB. HOL4 saves m ' x = THE (FLOOKUP m x) only under FLOOKUP m x <> NONE (finite_mapScript.sml:3951). It leaves open both FEMPTY ' x = THE NONE and FEMPTY ' x = ARB. Inside the domain the two definitions agree.
findings.repair:
noncomputable opaque FAPPLY_undef (β : Type v) [Nonempty β] : β

noncomputable def FAPPLY [Nonempty β] (f : fmap α β) (x : α) : β :=
  match FLOOKUP f x with
  | some y => y
  | none => FAPPLY_undef β
findings.lean_check:
import CmlTS.Prelude.Fmap
open CmlTS

theorem chk_THE (x : Nat) : FAPPLY (FEMPTY : fmap Nat Nat) x = THE (none : Option Nat) := rfl

theorem chk_ARB (x : Nat) : FAPPLY (FEMPTY : fmap Nat Nat) x = (ARB : Nat) := rfl
